description: In every expansion satisfying the definitions, the specified formula translation satisfies \(A^-[v]\leftrightarrow A[v]\) for every assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage.realize_translate.{u, v, u', v', w, z}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {K : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type z} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage L K) [(L.sum K).Structure M]
  [FirstOrder.Language.LHom.sumInl.IsExpansionOn M] (h : d.GoodExpansion M) (A : (L.sum K).Formula α) (v : α → M) :
  (d.translate A).Realize v ↔ A.Realize v
